entries.title: Hebrews 11:1
segments: Now faith is the title-deed of things hoped for; the putting to the proof of things not seen.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:2
segments: For by it men of old times had witness borne to them.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:3
segments: By faith we understand that the world was fashioned by the Word of God, so that what we see was not made out of what is visible.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:4
segments: By faith Abel offered to God a sacrifice more acceptable than that of Cain, through which he had witness borne to him that he was righteous, God giving the testimony by accepting his gifts; and through it he, although he is dead, still speaks.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:5
segments: By faith Enoch was translated so that he should not see death; and he was not found, because God had translated him. Before his translation he had witness borne to him that he pleased God:

entries.title: Hebrews 11:6
segments: now without faith it is impossible to please him; for he who comes to God must believe that he is, and that he ever rewards those who are seeking.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:7
segments: By faith Noah, warned of God of things not yet seen, reverently gave heed, and built an ark for the saving of his house; by which he condemned the world, and became an heir of the righteousness which is of faith.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:8
segments: By faith Abraham obeyed when he was called to go out unto a place which he was to receive for an inheritance; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:9
segments: It was by faith that he sojourned in the promised land as an alien, living in tents with Isaac and Jacob, his fellow heirs of the same promise.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:10
segments: For he continually looked for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:11
segments: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive seed, although she was past the age for child-bearing, because she counted Him faithful who had promised;

entries.title: Hebrews 11:12
segments: and thus there sprang from one man, and him practically dead, a nation like the stars in the heavens in multitude, or grains of sand upon the seashore, innumerable.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:13
segments: These all died in faith, not having yet received the promises; nay, but they saw them from afar, and hailed them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:14
segments: For those who say such things make it plain that they are seeking a Fatherland.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:15
segments: And if they had cherished the memory of that land from which they went out, they would have found an opportunity to return;

entries.title: Hebrews 11:16
segments: but now they are longing for a better homeland, that is, a heavenly. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God; and he has prepared a city for them.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:17
segments: By faith Abraham, when he was put to the test, was on the point of offering up Isaac; yes, he who had received the promise was about to offer up his only son,

entries.title: Hebrews 11:18
segments: of whom it had been said, It is through Isaac that your posterity will be traced.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:19
segments: For he accounted God able even to raise from the dead, from whence, figuratively speaking, he did indeed receive him back again.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:20
segments: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:21
segments: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of Joseph's sons, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:22
segments: By faith Joseph, when his end was nigh, made mention of the exodus of the children of Israel, and gave instructions in regard to his bones.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:23
segments: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid of the king's decree.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:24
segments: By faith Moses, when he was grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter,

entries.title: Hebrews 11:25
segments: choosing rather to share ill-treatment with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:26
segments: He accounted the obloquy of Christ to be greater than the treasures of Egypt; for he fixed his eyes on the reward.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:27
segments: By faith he left Egypt, not because he feared the wrath of the king, but he endured as seeing Him who is invisible.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:28
segments: By faith he established the Passover, and the sprinkling with blood, in order that the Destroying Angel might not touch the firstborn.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:29
segments: By faith the people crossed over the Red Sea as on dry land; and when the Egyptians tried to do this they were swallowed up.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:30
segments: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they had been encircled seven days.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:31
segments: By faith Rahab, the harlot, perished not with the disobedient, because she had received the spies in peace.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:32
segments: And what more shall I say? for time would fail me to tell of Gideon, of Barak, of Samson, and of Jeptha; of David and Samuel and the prophets,

entries.title: Hebrews 11:33
segments: who through faith conquered kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,

entries.title: Hebrews 11:34
segments: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, proved valiant in warfare, and routed armies of aliens.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:35
segments: Woman received their dear ones alive from the dead; and others were broken on the wheel, not accepting the offered deliverance, in order that they might obtain a better resurrection.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:36
segments: Others again bore trial of mockings and scourgings, yes, even of chains and imprisonment.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:37
segments: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, they were tempted, they were slain with the sword, they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins, being destitute, persecuted, tormented--

entries.title: Hebrews 11:38
segments: of whom the world was not worthy--wandering in deserts and mountains and caves and holes in the ground.

entries.title: Hebrews 11:39
segments: Yet, though these all had witness borne to them by their faith, they received not the promise;

entries.title: Hebrews 11:40
segments: since it was for us that God had in store some better thing, so that apart from us they should not be perfected.
